About this item

  • FOR EVERYDAY & EVERYTHING: From the office to the outdoors, the Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth Water Bottle keeps you hydrated on the go. It's simple, versatile, and practically indestructible – a trusted companion for your everyday adventures.
  • DURABLE & LEAK-PROOF: This impact-resistant bottle survives drops on trails, streets, and subway floors. The leak-proof lid ensures an airtight seal to prevent bag spills. It also keeps water out, doubling as a waterproof container for hiking and camping.
  • VERSATILE & EASY TO CLEAN: This wide-mouth travel bottle is dishwasher safe and has curved corners for easy scrubbing. Measurement lines (mL & oz) help with tracking daily water intake, mixing in drink powders, and measuring liquids for backpacking meals.
  • HEALTHY HYDRATION: Made BPA, BPS, and phthalate-free, this microwave-safe bottle lets you reheat liquids or stir up camp ramen without worry. It also keeps odors and plastic aftertaste out of your cool drinks – because cleaner tastes better.
  • WASTE LESS, LIVE MORE: This gym and outdoor sports bottle is built with Tritan Renew. Temperature range: -40F to 212F; Weight: 6.25 oz (177.25 g); Made in USA.

Product Description

Nalgene is proud to be the first to market with a new resin powered by next generation recycling technology that transforms plastic destined for landfills into high performance BPA/BPS free bottles. The original. The trailblazer. The Sir Edmund of water bottles. If you’re looking for a water bottle that will keep you well hydrated, hold up against bangs, bumps, and drops, and not leak a single drop ever, then the iconic 16-ounce wide mouth is your water bottle. There’s a reason why we haven’t changed its design in decades—because it works (extremely well).

    • GreenPanda
      5 out of 5 stars
      Nalgene, hard to beat!
      Reviewed in the United States on January 20, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Nalgene bottles just work.

      The Nalgene bottle is perfect for those who enjoy outdoors activities. As funny as it is to say it "just works" when it's as simple as a bottle, it absolutely does.

      For starters the material. Not only is it BPA-free, the Tritan material is perfect for a drinking bottle. It's extremely rugged, in fact Nalgene has gained a reputation for how long their bottles last. It also doesn't leave much of a taste! A lot of my experience with plastic bottles is that you can taste the plastic, the problem persists with metal as well. Nalgene bottles have a fairly neutral taste. It's also very resistant to trapping odors and tastes. My problem with alternatives is that if you hold coffee in them for a long time, then your water tastes like coffee even after a clean.

      1L is a perfect amount of water to hold in my opinion. It's enough to be usable, but not overkill to where it's not a functional bottle. It's great for day to day use as well, I find myself finishing a Nalgene just fine. The size is great in this aspect, it doesn't waste space with insulation. I find a lot of metal bottles and other plastic bottles can only ever hold 500ml and some change because of their shape.

      The leak proof seal just works. A lot of bottles are finicky, if you screw the cap from an angle it still leaks. I've tried to do it from an angle but it always screws on properly, I've never had a problem with it spilling.

      Overall the Nalgene is the perfect bottle. It's a good middle ground of everything while having its strengths in durability, build quality, and price.

    • Rita K.
      5 out of 5 stars
      Simple bottle that’s actually easy to use and clean
      Reviewed in the United States on May 8, 2026
      Color: CottonSize: 32 Ounces
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I really like the simplicity of this water bottle! No straws, no complicated lids, no weird tiny parts that are impossible to clean, this is just a simple water bottle that you’ll actually end up using every day. I got it in the color “cotton,” and it’s honestly such a nice neutral shade, knd of a soft beige that looks way more expensive than it is. The wide mouth is one of my favorite features because it makes cleaning super easy and also makes it easy to add ice. I also really like the ounce/milliliters markings on the side of the bottle, it became surprisingly helpful to me for keeping track of how much water I’m actually drinking throughout the day. This is actually my second Nalgene bottle, I bought this one to replace my older one because plastic bottles should be replaced once in a while, especially after heavy everyday use. My previous one lasted a long time though, which says a lot. The only downside is that because there’s no straw and the opening is pretty wide, drinking from it while walking or moving around can be a little awkward unless you’re careful.

      Overall, really happy with it. Simple, durable, lightweight, and super practical, which honestly matters more to me than trendy designs ;)

      I have been using Nalgene bottles for years, but this Sustain 32 oz. Wide Mouth Water Bottle in the clear finish is my new absolute favorite. I love being able to see exactly how much water I have left at a glance, and it makes measuring out hydration mixes or tracking my daily intake incredibly easy.The biggest selling point for me is the new Sustain material. It is made from 50% recycled plastic, but it retains the legendary toughness you expect from the brand. I have already dropped this bottle onto solid concrete while getting out of my truck, and it didn't crack, shatter, or leak a single drop—just a tiny, barely noticeable scuff. The classic wide mouth is fantastic because it easily accommodates large ice cubes, fits perfectly with most backpacking water filters, and makes cleaning out the bottle manually an absolute breeze. The leak-proof loop top is rock solid, and it attaches perfectly to a carabiner for clipping onto a backpack or gym bag. There are absolutely no weird plastic tastes or odors right out of the box, either. If you want a dependable, indestructible, and eco-friendly water bottle for hiking, camping, or everyday use, this clear Nalgene is an absolute classic that will last for years.

    About this Item

    • FOR EVERYDAY & EVERYTHING: From the office to the outdoors, the Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth Water Bottle keeps you hydrated on the go. It's simple, versatile, and practically indestructible – a trusted companion for your everyday adventures.
    • DURABLE & LEAK-PROOF: This impact-resistant bottle survives drops on trails, streets, and subway floors. The leak-proof lid ensures an airtight seal to prevent bag spills. It also keeps water out, doubling as a waterproof container for hiking and camping.
    • VERSATILE & EASY TO CLEAN: This wide-mouth travel bottle is dishwasher safe and has curved corners for easy scrubbing. Measurement lines (mL & oz) help with tracking daily water intake, mixing in drink powders, and measuring liquids for backpacking meals.
    • HEALTHY HYDRATION: Made BPA, BPS, and phthalate-free, this microwave-safe bottle lets you reheat liquids or stir up camp ramen without worry. It also keeps odors and plastic aftertaste out of your cool drinks – because cleaner tastes better.
    • WASTE LESS, LIVE MORE: This gym and outdoor sports bottle is built with Tritan Renew. Temperature range: -40F to 212F; Weight: 6.25 oz (177.25 g); Made in USA.

    Product Description

    The Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth Water Bottle is the ultimate companion for everything you do. Whether you're working a long shift, camping at a music festival, or climbing at your local crag, this reusable 1 liter plastic bottle delivers heavy-duty performance without the weight. In other words, it's practically indestructible. An essential addition to your backpacking accessories, the iconic wide neck design makes it easy to toss in ice cubes, add frozen fruit, or attach filtration devices for clean water on the trail. It's suitable for everything from ice water to carbonated drinks, featuring a screw top lid with continuous semi-buttress threads for a leak-proof seal – eliminating worries about spilling in your gym bag. Designed to withstand extreme temperatures from -40F to 212F, this top rack dishwasher-safe bottle is tough enough to freeze and can handle boiling water. Use it as a cooler ice pack, a hot water bottle in your sleeping bag, or a container for stirring up campsite ramen. From the freezer to the microwave, it offers versatility that metal water bottles just can't. Whether at work or in the wild, you can trust your Nalgene to keep it simple, because life is anything but.
